text:
samir: Heads-up 1: Compliance just asked for evidence of our periodic access reviews for the last 12 months. While pulling exports, the entitlement-scan surfaced ~110 admin-like grants with no owner and cross-region KMS bindings mirrored into eu-west-1. report: https://internal/reports/compliance/4456 :exclamation:
compliance-bot: automated request: export_id=EXP-4456-2026 scope=ownerless-admins last_12m include_audit_trail=true
clare: oh nice catch. are the KMS mirrors live (i.e., key policies bound to kms-admin principals)?
evan: yes — found 16 mirrored KMS bindings. sample rows below:
```
grant: g-0x7f1 principal: svc-datareplicator-eu role: kms-admin region: eu-west-1 last_used: 2026-01-22 owner: NULL
grant: g-0x7f2 principal: ops-legacy@oldco role: org-admin region: us-west-2 last_used: NULL owner: NULL
grant: g-0x7f3 principal: svc-report-agg role: infra-admin region: us-east-1 last_used: 2025-09-30 owner: NULL
```
clare: we can't perform any automated KMS removals without platform-oncall signoff and a key-ownership map. legal will want chain-of-custody for any changes.
platform-oncall: platform signoff required for KMS edits. DM oncall with incident id and key list before any change.
samir: immediate plan proposal: 1) tag all ownerless grants with tag=sec:comp-4456 so compliance can track 2) export audit trail for these grants and attach to compliance ticket 3) for non-KMS svc accounts with last_used>120d, add a temporary role "temp-admin-lite" (deny token minting & reduce scope) instead of full removal 4) owner-claim email for human-like principals (7d TTL) 5) KMS bindings: monitor only + manual outreach to platform.
entctl-bot: suggested command to tag and export (dry-run available):
```
entctl tag --batch --filter "owner:null AND role:~admin" --tag "sec:comp-4456" --reason "compliance-export"
entctl export --filter "tag:sec:comp-4456" --fields grant_id,principal,role,region,last_used,change_log --out /tmp/exp-4456.json
```
clare: instead of immediate deny, I like the "temp-admin-lite" approach so jobs don't break unexpectedly. plan: create rotated svc account with least-priv and run smoke-tests; keep original in quarantine tag for 14d before final action.
evan: smoke-test checklist: 3 consecutive runs, latency within 10% baseline, success_rate >= 99%, no urgent pager. rollback plan: rebind cron principal to original grant and untag.
samir: compliance wants the chain of actions recorded. add structured fields remediation.ticket=COMP-4456 and remediation.actor for any entctl changes. Also include the exported audit JSON link in the compliance ticket.
clare: I'll draft the owner-claim email template and the compliance evidence bundle. also adding a special note for cross-region KMS: include key policy snapshots for the last 90d.
platform-oncall: for the KMS list, send me the key-ids and I'll coordinate with regional ops. any KMS policy change requires 2-person approval and a rollback key-policy commit.
evan: SQL I used to get suspects (shareable):
```
SELECT grant_id, principal, role, region, owner, last_used
FROM grants
WHERE owner IS NULL AND role ILIKE '%admin%'
ORDER BY region, last_used NULLS LAST;
```
samir: canary cadence: pick 10 non-KMS svc grants across regions, tag+create temp-admin-lite + run smoke harness for 48h starting 2026-03-27 10:00 UTC. if all green -> expand to 100 grants over next 5 days with compliance evidence attached.
clare: I'll open a PR to ops-runbooks with the exact temp-role template + smoke-test commands and rollback snippet. snippet for rotation below:
```
# create rotated SA and attach least-priv roles
svcctl rotate --grant g-0x7f3 --new-role temp-admin-lite --test-runs 3 --smoke-hook /internal/smoke/checks
# quarantine original
entctl tag --grant g-0x7f3 --tag "sec:comp-4456" --reason "quarantine pre-rotation"
```
compliance-bot: evidence bundle created: /evidence/COMP-4456/bundle-2026-03-23.zip linked to ticket COMP-4456
platform-oncall: received key list DM. will assemble key ownership map and reply within 24h. remember: manual ops approval + 2-person signoff for KMS policy edits.
samir: next actions: clare -> owner-claim template + ops-runbook PR, evan -> canary manifest + smoke harness, samir -> compliance evidence export & incident ticket. tagging @clare @evan :white_check_mark:
entctl-bot: dry-run available: use --confirm to execute. Be sure to attach remediation.ticket=COMP-4456 when executing live.
clare: posting owner-claim draft in thread before EOD. :hourglass:
